judgment.rationale: Both are Key Unit Competence statements (same grain) in P1, Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations', Sub-Topic Area 'Whole Numbers', with identical skill verb sets (count, read, write, compare, order, add, subtract). The only substantive difference is number range: the second SFI covers whole numbers 0 to 10 (Unit 3, 5 periods) and the first covers whole numbers 0 to 50 (Unit 5, 20 periods). Mastery of counting, reading, writing, ordering, comparing, adding and subtracting within 0-10 substantively supports success with the same operations extended to 0-50, which requires the smaller range plus place-value/tens extension; this is a pair-specific broadening of numerical range rather than generic repetition. Coordinates are equal rank (P1), so direction rests on this range/complexity extension evidence, pointing from the 0-10 competence to the 0-50 competence. Both endpoints' source evidence is truncated with 24 omitted source-evidence items each, so only the quoted competence statements and hierarchy context were available; the merge context on the shared Topic Area, Sub-Topic Area and Grade ancestors means shared ancestry was treated as nominating context only, not as evidence of relation.
